name: prvision
description: Local-first visual review of UI changes in pull requests, branches and working trees

scripts.setup: npm run setup:install && npm run setup:env && npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run setup:browsers && npm run setup:datadir
scripts.setup:install: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait postgres redis
scripts.predev: npm run dev:clean && node backend/scripts/setup-env.mjs --check && npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix backend && npm run format:check --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.verify: npm run verify --prefix backend && npm run verify --prefix frontend
